GRANT IMPERSONATE ON USER::HamithaL TO AccountsPayable17;
GRANT CONTROL ON XML SCHEMA COLLECTION::Sales.Invoices4 TO RosaQdM;

OPEN SYMMETRIC KEY SymKey01 DECRYPTION BY CERTIFICATE Cert01 WITH PASSWORD = 'p';
CLOSE SYMMETRIC KEY SymKey01;
CLOSE ALL SYMMETRIC KEYS;

ADD SENSITIVITY CLASSIFICATION TO dbo.sales.price, dbo.sales.discount WITH (LABEL = 'Highly Confidential', INFORMATION_TYPE = 'Financial', RANK = CRITICAL);

================================================================================
Definitions in a batch with no semicolons
================================================================================

IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.t') IS NOT NULL
    DROP TABLE dbo.t
CREATE TABLE dbo.t (a int)
CREATE INDEX ix ON dbo.t (a)
GRANT SELECT ON dbo.t TO public
ALTER TABLE dbo.t ADD b int
UPDATE STATISTICS dbo.t
DROP INDEX ix ON dbo.t
SELECT 1

---
